<style>
/* Final: UNO limpo e comportamento SIM/NÃO controlado */
#uno{overflow:hidden!important}
#uno:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-90px;bottom:-110px;width:430px;height:300px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ff4f9b33 0,#ff4f9b12 45%,transparent 72%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
#uno .unopic{position:absolute!important;left:18px!important;bottom:16px!important;width:300px!important;max-width:48%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:205px!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:left bottom!important;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 26px #000c)!important;z-index:2!important}
#uno h3,#uno p,#uno .btn{z-index:4}
#uno .yes{left:61%!important;top:45%!important}
#uno .no{left:61%!important;top:63%!important}
#forever .yes{left:22%!important;top:45%!important}
#forever .no{left:58%!important;top:45%!important}
</style>
<script>
(() => {
  const UNO_DATA='data:image/png;base64,[... ELLIPSIZATION ...]... (truncated) ...';

  function installUno(){
    const img=document.querySelector('#uno .unopic');
    if(!img) return;
    img.onerror=null;
    img.src=UNO_DATA;
    img.alt='Fiat Uno';
  }

  function clearExtraYes(field){
    field.querySelectorAll('.tiny').forEach(el=>el.remove());
  }

  function addOneYes(field, yes, index){
    const labels=['SIM ♡','CLARO QUE SIM','ÓBVIO ♡','SIM, POR FAVOR ♡','MIL VEZES SIM ♡','SIMMM ♡'];
    const spots=[[73,28],[48,25],[75,75],[44,76],[24,67],[22,31]];
    if(index>=labels.length) return;
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='btn tiny';
    b.textContent=labels[index];
    b.style.left=spots[index][0]+'%';
    b.style.top=spots[index][1]+'%';
    b.onclick=yes;
    field.appendChild(b);
  }

  function moveNo(button, field, step){
    const spots=[[58,45],[69,58],[45,56],[76,42],[55,73],[71,70],[39,43]];
    const p=spots[step%spots.length];
    button.style.left=p[0]+'%';
    button.style.top=p[1]+'%';
  }

  window.wireNo=function(id,fieldId,yes){
    const field=document.getElementById(fieldId);
    const old=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!field||!old) return;
    clearExtraYes(field);
    const no=old.cloneNode(true);
    no.id=id;
    old.replaceWith(no);
    no.style.position='absolute';
    let hoverCount=0;
    moveNo(no,field,0);

    // Só cria novos SIM quando o mouse ENTRA no NÃO.
    no.addEventListener('mouseenter',ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault();
      if(hoverCount<6) addOneYes(field,yes,hoverCount);
      hoverCount++;
      if(typeof playDodge==='function') playDodge();
      moveNo(no,field,hoverCount);
    });

    // NÃO continua impossível de selecionar, mas clicar não cria botões extras.
    no.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
      ev.preventDefault();ev.stopPropagation();
      if(typeof playDodge==='function') playDodge();
      moveNo(no,field,hoverCount+1);
    });
  };

  window.showFinal=function(){
    show('final','final_questions','CRITICAL');
    const forever=document.getElementById('forever');
    const uno=document.getElementById('uno');
    if(forever) clearExtraYes(forever);
    if(uno){
      clearExtraYes(uno);
      uno.style.opacity='.38';
      uno.style.pointerEvents='none';
      uno.classList.remove('ready');
    }
    installUno();
    wireNo('foreverNo','forever',unlockUno);
  };

  window.unlockUno=function(){
    const uno=document.getElementById('uno');
    if(!uno) return;
    clearExtraYes(uno);
    uno.style.opacity='1';
    uno.style.pointerEvents='auto';
    uno.classList.add('ready');
    installUno();
    wireNo('unoNo','uno',showDeploy);
  };

  installUno();
})();
</script>
